{{Quote|There is a lady named Selan Ellison at the Starport. Maybe she could help you.|[[C-3TC]], to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]|<ref name="SWG:SC" />}}
'''Selan Ellison''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she was present for some time in the city of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]], on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:SC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] investigated the disappearance of a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] transporting a man named [[Valance Serth]] while traveling from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to Naboo. Following the advice of Serth's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3TC]], they interrogated Ellison in the lobby of the [[Moenia Starport]] about the whereabout of the missing shuttle. Selan Ellison did not have any information but she advised them to visit one of her acquaintances, [[Amarent Loren]], who worked for the [[Corellian Port Authority]] at the [[Tyrena Starport]] on Corellia. Loren eventually revealed that Valance Serth's shuttle had crashed on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG:SC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommonerHumanFemale.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Selan Ellison]]
Selan Ellison was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Selan Ellison was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> During each server reset, Ellison's appearance was randomized, but she consistently appeared as a Human female.<ref name="SWG:SC" />
